title: Two test visits
prompt: A teammate needs two made-up visits, with nested vitals and a list of codes, to test a dashboard. Write `solve()` so it builds them with exactly the columns and types below.
rules: Columns, in order: `encounter_id` (text), `vitals` (a struct with `heart_rate` as int, then `temperature_c` as double), `diagnosis_codes` (an array of text).
Visit `T1`: heart rate 88, temperature 36.9, one code `J06.9`.
Visit `T2` was by video: the whole `vitals` value is missing. Its codes are `Z00.00` and `E78.5`, in that order.
hints: Nest a `StructType` inside a `StructField` for `vitals`, and use `ArrayType(StringType())` for the codes.
A struct value is a tuple with one item per field; an array value is a Python list.
Missing vitals is `None` for the whole struct, not a tuple of `None`s.
